title: SWEEP-2026-10-13-GATES
universal_lens: The structural wiring audit formalizes a directed acyclic graph (DAG) over code modules. Reachability is defined by the transitive closure of non-test production importers, treating barrel re-exports as identity morphisms. The resulting operator measures the topological distance between theoretical specification and live execution manifolds.
gsi_mapping: In GSI, the census acts as a prior over latent primitive existence. The transition from 'SPEC-ONLY' to 'WIRED-LIVE' represents a Bayesian update conditioned on empirical dependency edges. Conformal prediction intervals tighten only when the underlying causal primitives are structurally integrated into the active inference pipeline.
gse_mapping: GSE situational reasoning maps these states to an automaton: SPEC-ONLY is a dormant potential state; LANDED-NOT-WIRED is a trapped intermediate state; WIRED-LIVE is an active kinetic state. State transitions require explicit wiring events, preventing unanchored theoretical constructs from influencing real-time game dynamics.

primitives.name: Production Reachability Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: Structural backbone: packages/prediction-engine/src/index.ts is a pure re-export barrel; a PE module is only reachable in production if the barrel reaches it AND some production file imports the barrel.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: M: Module set (dimensionless), B: Barrel node (dimensionless), R: Reachability relation (boolean), I: Production importer set (boolean).
primitives.assumptions: The dependency graph is strictly acyclic; test files form a disjoint set from production files; barrel exports do not introduce side effects.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Breaks down under circular dependencies or dynamic runtime evaluation (e.g., eval()) which bypasses static import resolution.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to the support function of a measure on the module space. Only modules with non-zero measure in the production importer set contribute to the active GSE/GSI state.
layer2.telemetry: Count of non-test production importers per module.

reasoning_traces.retrocausal_genealogy: This structural auditing methodology traces its lineage to early compiler theory and link-time optimization, specifically the concept of dead code elimination. Historically, mathematicians and computer scientists sought to minimize the execution footprint by pruning unreachable states in finite automata. In the context of modern quantitative sports intelligence, this evolves from simple static analysis into a profound epistemic tool. It mirrors the historical shift in physics from enumerating all possible particle interactions to focusing exclusively on those permitted by conservation laws and active symmetries. The census acts as a retrocausal filter, validating only those theoretical constructs that have successfully bridged the gap between abstract specification and concrete, production-grade implementation.
reasoning_traces.theory_of_mind: Modeling the development team as rational agents reveals a fascinating tension between theoretical ambition and engineering pragmatism. The existence of 157 SPEC-ONLY modules suggests a 'theorist' agent continuously generating complex, high-dimensional primitives (e.g., hierarchical AR1 shrinkage, PCMI panels) anticipating future utility. Conversely, the 'engineer' agent enforces a strict parsimony, wiring only the absolute minimum required for current functionality, exemplified by the solitary G-09 gate. This opposition creates a strategic standoff: the theorist hoards potential energy in the form of unwired code, while the engineer minimizes kinetic risk by isolating the live execution path. Understanding this dynamic allows us to predict future wiring events not as random deployments, but as calculated resolutions to specific predictive failures that the current sparse active set cannot address.
reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: Anti-collinearity and leakage vetoes are paramount when integrating new primitives from the quarantined or spec-only pools. If a newly wired module shares excessive structural similarity with an already active component, it introduces collinearity, destabilizing the conformal prediction intervals without adding orthogonal information. The cross-layer veto mechanism must therefore evaluate not just reachability, but the geometric independence of the new primitive's feature space relative to the existing active manifold. Furthermore, leakage vetoes ensure that no spec-only module inadvertently accesses live production data through shared global states or implicit dependencies, which would corrupt the clean separation between theoretical exploration and live inference. Only primitives that pass both topological reachability and geometric orthogonality checks should be permitted to transition to the WIRED-LIVE state.
